description: Create a directory (and any missing parents) inside the allowed roots. Without confirm: true this only reports the plan.

path.description: Absolute path. Must resolve inside a configured root; relative paths are refused.

plan_token.description: The plan_token this tool returned when called without confirm. Required with confirm: true, single use, and only valid while the plan still matches the tree.
